Specify a VGG feature hierarchy

Source: R/hierarchy_spec.R
vgg_hierarchy_spec.Rd

A spec names the layers to tap and says how each one is pooled over space. Pass it to extract_feature_hierarchy to get one feature block per stage.

Usage

vgg_hierarchy_spec(
  architecture = c("vgg16", "vgg19"),
  taps = NULL,
  pooling = NULL,
  target_size = c(224, 224)
)

Arguments

architecture

"vgg16" or "vgg19".

taps

Named character vector mapping stage names to Keras layer names. The virtual tap "classifier_logits" requests pre-softmax ImageNet logits. Defaults to vgg_block_end_taps.

pooling

How to pool each stage over space; see poolers for the options. Supply one of:

  • NULL (default): global_average_pool for convolutional taps and identity_pool for dense taps.

  • A single pooler, used for every stage. Dense stages have no spatial axes and pass through unchanged whatever the pooler.

  • A named list with one pooler per stage. Names must cover every stage in taps.

target_size

Image resize dimensions passed to Keras.

Value

An object of class c("vgg_hierarchy_spec", "feature_hierarchy_spec").

See also

vgg16_block_end_spec for a ready-made spec, poolers, and vignette("spatial-pooling", package = "imfeatures").

Examples

# Default: global average pooling on convolutional stages
vgg_hierarchy_spec("vgg16")
#> VGG hierarchy spec (vgg16)
#>   Stages: b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, fc1, logits
#>   Taps:   block1_conv2, block2_conv2, block3_conv3, block4_conv3, block5_conv3, fc1, classifier_logits
#>   Pooling:
#>     b1      Global average pool
#>     b2      Global average pool
#>     b3      Global average pool
#>     b4      Global average pool
#>     b5      Global average pool
#>     fc1     Identity pool
#>     logits  Identity pool

# One pooler for every stage
vgg_hierarchy_spec("vgg16", pooling = adaptive_grid_pool(2, 2))
#> VGG hierarchy spec (vgg16)
#>   Stages: b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, fc1, logits
#>   Taps:   block1_conv2, block2_conv2, block3_conv3, block4_conv3, block5_conv3, fc1, classifier_logits
#>   Pooling:
#>     b1      Adaptive grid pool 2 x 2
#>     b2      Adaptive grid pool 2 x 2
#>     b3      Adaptive grid pool 2 x 2
#>     b4      Adaptive grid pool 2 x 2
#>     b5      Adaptive grid pool 2 x 2
#>     fc1     Adaptive grid pool 2 x 2
#>     logits  Adaptive grid pool 2 x 2

# A different pooler per stage
vgg_hierarchy_spec(
  "vgg16",
  taps = c(b4 = "block4_conv3", b5 = "block5_conv3", fc1 = "fc1"),
  pooling = list(
    b4 = dct_pool(3, 3),
    b5 = radial_pool(),
    fc1 = identity_pool()
  )
)
#> VGG hierarchy spec (vgg16)
#>   Stages: b4, b5, fc1
#>   Taps:   block4_conv3, block5_conv3, fc1
#>   Pooling:
#>     b4   DCT pool 3 x 3 (zigzag)
#>     b5   Radial pool (0, 0.25, 0.5, 1)
#>     fc1  Identity pool
